If true, it creates an Intent using getIntent() and calls Util.startForegroundService(context, intent). If false, it creates an Intent and calls context.startService(intent) inside an existing try-catch that catches IllegalStateException. SecurityException could also occur but is not handled in either branch; however, it is often a symptom of permission issues that should be fixed rather than caught.
